The '''Fallow Sanctuary''' is the village of a [[tribe]] of [[Draenei]] simply called the [[Lost Ones (organization)|"Lost Ones"]], who live in the [[Swamp of Sorrows]]. All the Lost Ones here have been driven mad with homesickness and turned completely feral.
